Connect

Open a connection to a Trino coordinator, choose how to authenticate and how to verify its certificate.

Trino()
Instantiate the Trino driver
dbConnect(<TrinoDriver>)
Connect to a Trino cluster
trino_auth_basic() trino_auth_jwt() trino_auth_oauth2()
Authentication methods for Trino
trino_ssl()
TLS options for a Trino connection
dbDisconnect(<TrinoConnection>)
Disconnect from Trino
dbIsValid(<TrinoConnection>) dbIsValid(<TrinoResult>)
Is this connection or result still usable?

Run queries

Submit SQL and pull the rows back, in one go or in chunks.

dbGetQuery(<TrinoConnection>,<character>)
Run a query and return all of its rows
dbSendQuery(<TrinoConnection>,<character>)
Submit a statement to Trino
dbSendStatement(<TrinoConnection>,<character>)
Submit a statement that changes something
dbExecute(<TrinoConnection>,<character>)
Execute a statement that returns no rows
dbFetch(<TrinoResult>)
Fetch rows from a Trino result
dbHasCompleted(<TrinoResult>)
Have all rows of a result been consumed?
dbClearResult(<TrinoResult>)
Release a Trino result
dbBind(<TrinoResult>)
Parameters are not supported

dbAppendTable(<TrinoConnection>)

dbWriteTable(<TrinoConnection>,<ANY>) dbWriteTable(<TrinoConnection>,<Id>)

Rename a table
dbRemoveTable(<TrinoConnection>,<character>) dbRemoveTable(<TrinoConnection>,<Id>) dbRemoveTable(<TrinoConnection>,<ANY>)
